profile.name: Suriya Dhayalan
profile.tagline: AI Engineer building RAG search, Generative AI and AI agents — with a strong full-stack background.
profile.specialization: AI Engineer · RAG · Generative AI · AI Agents · Full-Stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js)
profile.bio: AI Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience and a strong full-stack background in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js. I build production AI features: a RAG assistant with pgvector semantic search, a tool-calling AI agent with human approval, an LLM evaluation suite, AI call transcription and analysis, and a real-time deepfake detection system for video interviews. I focus on safe and testable AI — validated LLM outputs, PII masking, audit logs, and fallbacks when a model fails. My full-stack skills let me own an AI feature end to end, from the model call to the UI and deployment.

experience.summary: Working on full-stack projects and building AI chatbots, RAG and Generative AI features — on a Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL stack.
highlights: Full-stack projects: built SalesRocks features (multi-tenant setup, two-factor login, in-browser calling, dashboards), Atna Product modules and the company website.
AI chatbot: built Ask AI — a chat assistant that streams answers, cites sources and suggests follow-up questions.
RAG: built the vector search pipeline — data is chunked, embedded with Gemini embeddings and searched with PostgreSQL + pgvector.
Generative AI: built Do AI, an AI agent with LLM function calling, and AI call analysis with Gemini + Claude structured outputs.
Safe AI: LLM eval suite (32 + 10 checks), PII masking, Zod validation, audit logs and model fallbacks.
AI video security: built the Deepfake Meeting Guardian for Google Meet, Teams and Zoom interviews.

Created reusable component libraries that sped up development across multiple projects.

projects.title: SalesRocks — AI Sales Product
projects.subtitle: RAG · Generative AI · Ask AI · Do AI
projects.description: An AI-powered sales platform. I built its AI features: a RAG assistant, a tool-calling AI agent with human approval, an LLM eval suite, PII masking and AI call analysis.
highlights: Ask AI (RAG): answers questions from the company's own calls, emails, leads and deals — streams answers, cites sources and suggests follow-up questions
Vector search: records are chunked, embedded with Gemini embeddings and stored in PostgreSQL + pgvector, indexed on save plus a 5-minute background job
Do AI (agent): uses LLM function calling to read data and propose actions (create task, draft email, score lead) — nothing runs until a person approves
Safe AI: every AI action is checked with Zod twice and logged for audit; PII is masked before it reaches the LLM
LLM evals: 32 known-answer checks + 10 system checks, run with one command, to catch mistakes when prompts change
AI call analysis: Gemini transcribes calls; Claude returns structured JSON — summary, sentiment, buying intent, objections, next steps
Switchable Gemini / Claude provider with safe fallbacks when a model or quota fails

projects.title: Meeting Bot — Deepfake Guardian
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI interview proctoring
projects.description: A system that checks whether a candidate in a Google Meet, Teams or Zoom interview is a real, live person — deepfake face, face swap, liveness, lip-sync and AI-voice checks.
highlights: Pluggable detection: frames and audio go to detector model servers, with a local TensorFlow.js model and audio heuristics as fallback
Iris-based eye-gaze tracking with MediaPipe to detect look-aways and tab switches — nothing to install for the candidate
3 capture methods: a server-side meeting bot (ffmpeg), browser screen capture, and a Chrome extension
Live audit dashboard with real-time risk scores, per-participant risk reports and bulk 'scan all deepfakes'
